title: A Portrait for the Alibi
author: Xanthe Ishikawa
blurb: Oscar Voss, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
